brief:
Zeteo reported this week that Israeli settlers killed a Palestinian grandmother, according to its weekly roundup of developments in occupied Gaza and the West Bank. The incident occurred as Israeli forces carried out a new ground offensive in the territory.

The deaths mark continued violence amid what Zeteo characterized as Israel's ongoing genocidal war and apartheid policies in the occupied Palestinian territories. The weekly summary flags the killing as among significant incidents across Gaza and the West Bank during the reporting period.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian grandmother in West Bank
